reviews.title: One Big, Chonky, Daring BEAST of a Card
reviews.comment: If you are a gamer that is looking to crush 1440p, or even get reasonable performance at 4K, I would redirect your attention to this huge thing. And when I say huge - it's LARGE. Takes up massive real estate in my 011 Vision Compact - heavy, robust, sleek, and constructed with high quality & durable materials. The lightbar is subtle, not obnoxious, it's honestly beautiful. Thankfully, the sheer volume of the unit is not for no reason. This card provides the excellent cooling solution that XFX touts, which appears to be the best in the 9070 XT's class on many benchmarks across the web. I can certainly vouch for it. I have never seen my card above 60⁰C core temp, pushing 300+ FPS at 1440p medium settings in BO7 (while undervolted and using a fan curve). Beyond impressed. Its price may seem sizeable to some, but when compared to other NVIDIA graphics cards that provide similar or WORSE performance, I'd recommend this above absolutely all of them, and it's not even close. You can feel the difference the second you take it out of the box. This thing is absolutely no joke. 10/10 get this card you will LOVE it.
reviews.author: JosephM
